brand_constraints.logo_rule: Deterministic overlay in reserved footer zone; never AI generated

campaign_message.audience_insight: Local business owners want fast, cost-free ways to attract foot traffic without dealing with complex ad managers or approval wait times.
campaign_message.core_promise: meelTe lets you post a single item deal in 60 seconds with instant discount badges and direct neighborhood discovery.
campaign_message.headline: Got a deal to share today?

visual_concept: A friendly local shopkeeper effortlessly transforms a physical product deal into a live digital promotion on their phone, seeing it instantly reach neighbors nearby.
style_direction: Playful Modern 2D Vector Illustration + Clean Mobile UI Motion. Smooth motion, soft shadows, uncluttered background, warm community vibe.

shot_plan.scene_description: Friendly shopkeeper in an approachable modern 2D vector style stands behind a clean wooden counter holding up a featured product with an inviting smile.
shot_plan.action: Shopkeeper sets product down on counter and gestures enthusiastically toward camera.
shot_plan.transition: Smooth cut to mobile screen view.
shot_plan.continuity: Warm shop lighting, lavender wall panel, charcoal accents, shopkeeper wears purple apron with orange trim.

shot_plan.scene_description: First-person perspective holding a sleek smartphone showing the meelTe app feed.
shot_plan.action: Thumb taps the purple '+' floating action button. Bottom sheet modal opens. Thumb selects 'Single Item Advertisement'. Camera viewfinder opens and snaps the product photo.
shot_plan.camera: Top-down / angled close-up on phone screen; slight tilt.
shot_plan.transition: Fast UI transition to ad configuration form.
shot_plan.continuity: Hand skin tone matches shopkeeper from SHOT-01; phone bezel charcoal.

shot_plan.scene_description: Form screen inside meelTe. Product photo previewed.
shot_plan.action: User inputs price. Taps discount toggle 'Flat %'. A vibrant orange badge 'FLAT 25% OFF' pops onto the image with a subtle bounce. Mini map card drops an orange pin on the storefront address.
shot_plan.camera: Direct UI focus; smooth scroll down form.
shot_plan.continuity: Brand purple buttons and orange badge highlight.

shot_plan.scene_description: Tapping 'Create Advertisement'. Instant green snackbar 'Advertisement created'.
shot_plan.action: Screen transitions smoothly to the live Advertisements Feed. The new ad appears right at the top with proximity badge '50m away'. Scene cuts to pedestrian on street noticing the notification on their phone and walking toward shop.
shot_plan.camera: Split/sequential: UI success cut to eye-level street scene.
shot_plan.continuity: Same product banner photo from SHOT-03; street has matching vector architecture.

shot_plan.scene_description: meelTe brand closing card. Deep purple canvas (#743BAA) with subtle curved lavender accent line.
shot_plan.action: meelTe wordmark scales in smoothly. Bold white headline 'Grow your store free' with a bright orange pill CTA button 'Try meelTe free'.
shot_plan.camera: Static locked card with gentle kinetic text pop.
shot_plan.continuity: Exact brand logo variant (reverse-white on purple).

captions.phrase: Got a deal to share today?

sfx_cues.description: Bouncy pop sound as orange badge attaches

unresolved_assumptions: Audio assets (voiceover MP3 and SFX WAV files) are synthesized or queued for post-production assembly.
Video rendering adapter is not yet wired to a live cloud GPU provider; full prompt package and deterministic Remotion template are provided.
